mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 68 degrees. We are in the First Quarter moon phase, and you can catch the ISS passing overhead at 4:10 AM tomorrow as it travels from Mount Horeb toward Madison. Our overnight low will be 60 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20th. Also, the city recently approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover essential maintenance and prevent system failures like flooding or sewer backups.

Tomorrow is packed with activity, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena on August 23rd.

In a report regarding incidents from August 10th to August 17th, on August 15th, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after she was found unresponsive in her vehicle near North Main Street.
Today's flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The shop is currently closed but will open its doors at 10:00 AM tomorrow, when the flavor changes to Raspberry Cheesecake.
